lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Primary high-luminance blobs are arranged in approximately five discernible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with the largest clusters situated along the mid-lateral axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the primary blobs, forming a repetitive grid where blobs serve as anchor nodes within each vertical stripe.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition from high luminance (dorsal side) to low luminance/shadow (ventral side).

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density statistical distribution of smaller high-luminance spots, which are significantly more numerous and smaller in diameter than the blobs on the lateral flank.
